_comment: Department of Basic Education Grade 10 Mathematics P1 (algebra, patterns, functions, finance and probability), November 2018 national common examination.
Questions and marking-guideline answers transcribed from the rendered pages of the official PDFs
(paper1.pdf, paper1_memo.pdf); the text layer does not hold usable equations. Notation:
^ for powers, sqrt() for roots, a/b for fractions, decimal commas as printed. memo_answer is the
guideline's final answer and memo_working its working (tick marks and mark descriptors left out).
The guideline is bilingual (English/Afrikaans); only the English is transcribed. Graphs and diagrams are described
in brackets in the question text. The information sheet printed with the paper is not transcribed.
The question paper is a scan with no text layer.

Solve simultaneously for x and y if: 5x + 4y = 21 and 2x = 3 - y
questions.memo_working: y = 3 - 2x; 5x + 4(3 - 2x) = 21; -3x = 9; x = -3; y = 3 - 2(-3). OR elimination: 8x + 4y = 12 minus 5x + 4y = 21 gives 3x = -9

questions.context: QUESTION 7 | Read the advertisement below. [Buy a Samsung J5 for only R229 per month. You have 24 months to pay. No deposit is required.]
questions.text: Calculate the total amount to be paid over a period of 24 months.

The monthly instalment, quoted in the advertisement, is calculated on a hire purchase agreement which charges interest of 7,5% p.a. on the cash price of the cellphone. Show that the price of the cellphone is R4 779,13.
Calculate the total interest paid over a period of 24 months if the cellphone is bought with this hire purchase agreement.

The cellphone is insured at 11,5% p.a of the cash price. The total insurance is calculated and then split up over 24 months. It is then added to the monthly instalment. Calculate the new monthly instalment if the customer wants to insure the cellphone.
The cost of the cellphone is subject to inflation and increases to a cash price of R5 100,00 after 2 years. Calculate the annual inflation rate.

questions.context: QUESTION 8 | 8.1 In a random physical sciences experiment, A and B are two different events. It was found that: P(A) = 2/5, P(B') = 3/8 and P(A or B) = 5/7. 8.1.1 Calculate:
questions.text: P(B)
P(A and B)
Hence, determine whether events A and B are mutually exclusive. Motivate your answer.
questions.memo_answer: Not mutually exclusive, since P(A and B) ≠ 0.

questions.context: 8.2 The Venn diagrams below represent different scenarios of events A and B. Write down the probability of the shaded region for EACH of the diagrams below.
questions.text: [Venn diagram: only the overlap of A and B is shaded.]
questions.memo_answer: P(A ∩ B) OR P(A and B)

questions.text: [Venn diagram: everything outside A and B is shaded.]
questions.memo_answer: P(A ∪ B)' OR P(A or B)'

questions.text: [Venn diagram: A and B are shaded except for their overlap.]
questions.memo_answer: P(A ∩ B)' OR P(A and B)'
questions.memo_note: As printed in the guideline; the shaded region drawn (A or B but not both) leaves out the region outside both circles, so it is P(A or B) - P(A and B) rather than P(A and B)'.
